fkt60a0k.variantName: Walplus 300 LED Lights Hinged Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 180 cm
fkt60a0k.sourceDescription: This modern Christmas tree decoration features a unique cone-shaped design, ideal for enhancing the festive atmosphere in any room or outdoor space. Crafted with PVC and PE materials, this piece offers a fade-resistant surface that ensures lasting appeal throughout the season. Premium Materials: Constructed from quality PVC and PE, this decorative item offers a fade-resistant exterior that withstands the test of time, maintaining its vibrant appearance throughout continuous use. Inclusive LED Lighting: Equipped with warm white LED decorative string lights that bring an elegant sparkle to your space. The warm glow offers a cozy, inviting ambiance that transforms any setting into a festive retreat. USB Connectivity: This decoration is powered via USB, offering flexible placement options. Whether it’s next to your indoor sleigh setup or enhancing your garden terrace, it seamlessly plugs into various devices for a hassle-free experience. Modern Aesthetic: With its sleek cone-shaped form and minimalist style, this decoration embodies modern decor principles. It harmonizes with both traditional and contemporary holiday displays. Simple Assembly: Requires assembly by two people, according to the manufacturer’s instructions, ensuring that every piece fits together perfectly and functions as intended. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

yh4enbbk.sourceDescription: Bring a foliage-inspired touch to your festive decorating with this artificial eucalyptus wreath. Its round design creates a welcoming feature on your front door or adds seasonal detail above a mantelpiece. Measuring approximately 45cm in diameter, the wreath works as a standalone decoration or alongside your existing Christmas display. Durable pine and plastic construction makes it reusable, so you can bring it out each festive season. Suitable for indoor and outdoor use, the wreath features a sturdy base for hanging on doors, walls or windows. You can also lay it flat as a table centrepiece. It weighs 600g and requires no special cleaning or maintenance. Key Features Artificial eucalyptus design for a foliage-inspired Christmas display. Round wreath measures approximately 45cm in diameter. Durable pine and plastic construction for repeated seasonal use. Suitable for indoor and outdoor display. Sturdy base for hanging on doors, walls or windows. Also suitable as a table centrepiece; weight: 600g. Please refer to product packaging Benross Marketing , 22 goodlass road , l24 9hj

nasyhajw.variantName: Outsunny 6ft Christmas Inflatable Santa on Sleigh with Reindeer - MultiColor
nasyhajw.sourceDescription: A magical winter scene in minutes with this Outsunny Christmas inflatable outdoor decoration. It comes in a joyful design: Santa leans forward in a colourful sleigh, reindeer in front, penguin by his side, with inner lights so it glows in the dark. All you need to do is plug it into the electric and watch it blow up and come to life. Comes with ground stakes and tethers to secure in place. ● Grand 180 cm design with Santa, reindeer and penguin. A fun, festive piece ● Five inner white LEDs so it glows beautifully at night ● Built-in blower inflates quickly, for simple, fast setup ● Six ground stakes, two tethers and two sandbags included. Keeps decoration grounded and in place ● IP44 water-resistant polyester shell is reliable and safe in mild weather ● Colour: Multi-Colored ● Material: 190T Polyester Fabric ● Overall Dimension: 180W x 120D x 155H cm ● Power Cable Length: 3 m ● LED Light Power (Single): 0.25W ● Blower: DC 12V/1.2A ● Input Voltage: 220-240V, 50/60Hz ● Output Voltage: DC 12V/1.5A ● Waterproof Rating: IP44 ● Item Label: 84J-143V70MX Warning: this product is not a toy. Keep away from children unless under adult supervision. Keep away from open flames and heat sources. If powered, disconnect before cleaning or storage and do not use if damaged.
